info.title: TLITODOS Backend API
info.description: FastAPI endpoint server for the TLITODOS shared todo-list app. This OpenAPI document is written for frontend and AI-agent consumption: field names match the JSON API contract, authenticated operations use BearerAuth, and upload endpoints explicitly document multipart/form-data.

tags.name: authorization
tags.description: Google login, current user profile, notifications, and Discord linking

tags.name: categories
tags.description: Per-user todo categories. A user can create up to 5 categories.

tags.name: todos
tags.description: Todo CRUD, subtasks, dependencies, and todo-scoped bet creation

tags.name: bets
tags.description: Bet status, proof upload, and verification

tags.name: diaries
tags.description: Diary entries with optional image uploads

post.summary: Log in with Google access token
post.description: Validates a Google access token, creates or updates the user, stores an API access token, and returns the TLITODOS bearer token.

patch.description: Accepts either JSON fields or multipart/form-data. Multipart uses field name image and returns profileImageUrl as /uploads/profiles/{filename}.

post.description: Exchanges a Discord OAuth authorization code for user information and stores the linked Discord username.

200.description: Groups the current user belongs to.

delete.description: Only a LEADER can remove another member. The leader cannot remove themselves through this endpoint.

200.description: Category updated. isDeletable is not included in this endpoint response.

delete.description: Non-deletable default categories, such as 취미, cannot be deleted.

get.description: Returns todos owned by the current user. Optional filters are exact matches.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Filter by dueDate string. The backend stores this as a string and compares it exactly.

patch.description: A todo can be completed only when all subtasks are completed.

post.description: Adds dependencyTodoId to the todo dependencies array. Todos in category id 1 cannot be linked as dependencies.

patch.description: When approved is true, the bet status becomes VERIFIED.

post.description: Accepts either JSON or multipart/form-data. Multipart image uploads return imageUrl as /uploads/diaries/{filename}.

BearerAuth.description: Use the accessToken returned by POST /api/v1/auth/google as Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}.

UnauthorizedError.description: Missing, expired, or invalid bearer token.

imageUrl.description: Static upload path such as /uploads/diaries/{filename}, or null.

createdAt.description: ISO-like datetime string generated by the backend.

googleAccessToken.description: Google OAuth access token from the frontend login flow.

expiresAt.description: UTC datetime string without timezone suffix, generated by the backend.

dueDate.description: Stored as a string. Use a consistent frontend format such as YYYY-MM-DD.

createdAt.description: ISO-like datetime string generated by the backend.

x-ai-agent-notes: Most endpoints except /ping and /api/v1/auth/google require Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}.
The backend uses camelCase JSON field names in request/response bodies even though many Python model attributes are snake_case.
Upload URLs are relative static paths served from /uploads.
The backend currently stores dueDate, createdAt, completedAt, expiresAt, and diary createdAt as strings rather than strict date-time schema values.
PATCH /api/v1/users/me and POST /api/v1/diaries accept multiple content types; choose multipart/form-data only when uploading an image.
